name: interfacial damage
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 结构相邻层间连接发生的损伤。
usage_overview: 在板式轨道分析中，用于描述轨道板与填充层之间的黏结退化，作为层间连接状态纳入车辆—轨道相互作用及损伤演化分析；在相应界面模型中，这种退化可表现为界面刚度下降。

complete_examples.text: It illustrates the necessity of considering the combined fatigue and interfacial damages of slab tracks instead of separately accounting for the fatigue or interfacial damage.
Consequently, the stress, strain and other response quantities required in the fatigue and interfacial damage assessment are all harvested.
The settlement and the interfacial damage should be integrated into the whole research.
The mean interfacial damage reaches 0.5748 once the settlement wavelength is 20 m and the amplitude is 80 mm.
